notes: Blind replication-only validation. Requested target: Relationship between flexibility (product cycle time) and simplicity (lean attitude) in the Swiss sample. Rendered primary PDF pp. 7 and 9 were inspected. Tables 6–7 are pooled regressions, not Swiss subgroup regressions. Table 4 explicitly distinguishes present-study measures from Collins et al. (1998) measures: the target outcome and named factor(s) belong to the earlier study. No country-specific coefficient/R-squared or same-test p is printed for this requested combination; all target statistics remain null. Switzerland is not among the 14 countries listed in present-study Table 1 (p. 937). Source is the published 2006 article copy (available online December 2005), retained as supplied. General support for the model is not a verdict for this absent country-specific test. Unassigned original side was not extracted.
